run_fairchem_cli_job: run a fairchem job by passing a YAML config file path to the main CLI entry point
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and parse a Hydra YAML config file with override arguments into a canonical DictConfig object
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
launch_slurm_job: launch a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with optional Ray support using the CLI scheduler
launch_local_job: launch a fairchem job locally with optional Ray cluster or torch elastic multi-rank support
